d:
Tujhe Bhula Diya is a song which is straight from the heart and has lyrics (by Kumaar and Vishal Dadlani) that would remain etched in memory, the song is sung by Mohit Chauhan, Shekhar Ravjiani, Shruti Pathak.
Song - Tujhe Bhula Diya
Film - Anjana Anjani
Singer - Mohit Chauhan, Shekhar Ravjiani, Shruti Pathak
Lyricist - Kumaar, Vishal Dadlani
Music Director - Vishal Dadlani, Shekhar Ravjiani
Artist - Priyanka Chopra, Ranbir Kapoor
Mix & Master- Eric Pillai @ Future Sound Of Bombay
